# `kernel/lib/sparc` — kernel library routines (libkern-style) — sparc

## English

This directory contains kernel library routines (libkern-style) — sparc.

`config.mk` records 6 source file(s) here: `mul.s`, `rem.s`, `sdiv.s`, `udiv.s`, `umul.s`, `urem.s`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
